testcases.name: lance-3b-x2t-image
testcases.prompt: What color is the vehicle in this image? Answer in one word.
testcases.notes: The family default builds BF16 split prefill/decode engines with TensorRT native KV cache at Lance's complete 128000-token context. Validation runs the pinned upstream x2t_image implementation against the same image and question used by TRTMC.
